## What it checks (sampled describe/it titles)

- Part Classifier — Family Detection (U-LPS01)
- classifies long solid as shaft (L/D > 3)
- classifies short part with bolt circle as flange
- classifies very short solid as disc (L/D < 0.3)
- classifies hollow cylinder as sleeve
- classifies short hollow with tight tolerance as bushing
